# WASM boundary inventory

Generated by `crates/larql-wasm/tools/census.py --inventory` — do not hand-edit;
regenerate on demand. The census is the source of truth for the wasm32v1-none
compile boundary.

## Legend

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| ✅ | compiles |
| ❌ | fails to compile |
| ⏸ | deferred — test-run columns are rewritten in the interface refactor |

**wasm32v1-none** = `cargo check --target wasm32v1-none --lib`; **native** = `cargo check --lib`. The `wasmi`/`node`/`firefox` test-RUN columns (`cargo test`) are intentionally deferred to the interface phase and tracked in CI, not here.
